description: Record an accept, reject or revise outcome on a single paper, optionally with private notes and feedback for the author. Use it after get_submission, when working through papers one at a time: read the reviews, decide, move on. IMPORTANT — this does NOT email anyone. The decision is saved privately and the author cannot see it. Always tell the user that nothing has been sent, and that to actually send decisions they must either open the event's Decisions page in Congressio and use "Finalize all", or ask you to run release_decisions, which emails every author at once and cannot be undone. Recording a decision can be repeated to change it while it is unsent. Pass the decision type's name as configured on the event, such as "Accept" or "Reject"; if you get it wrong the error lists the valid names. Requires an OAuth connection and the admin role on the event. If the response includes a `links` object or a `dashboardUrl`, give the user the actual URL as a clickable link rather than describing where to click — they are in a chat, not in the product, and cannot navigate from a description.

authorFeedback.description: Feedback the author WILL see — but only once decisions are released, not now.

decision.description: The decision type's name as configured on this event, e.g. "Accept", "Reject", "Minor revision".

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

notes.description: Private notes for the organizers. The author never sees these.

submissionId.description: Submission UUID from list_submissions or get_submission.

name: record_decision
title: Record a decision on one submission
